title: Project：并发任务队列 Milestone 2

project.title: 并发任务队列
project.portfolioOutcome: 一个具有明确任务所有权、线程生命周期、关闭策略、故障诊断和工程发布证据的任务队列。

objectives: 交付可安装的固定 worker 线程池，并用 CTest 固定 exact-once、排空关闭、停止接收和故障复盘证据。
victoryConditions: CMake/Threads 构建、真实 queue-contract CTest、集成输入、相对批量基准和 Portfolio 全部通过。

starterFiles.CMakeLists.txt:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(concurrent_task_queue LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
add_executable(concurrent-task-queue main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(concurrent-task-queue PRIVATE Threads::Threads)
enable_testing()
add_executable(task_queue_tests tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(task_queue_tests PRIVATE Threads::Threads)
target_compile_definitions(task_queue_tests PRIVATE PORTFOLIO_PATH=\"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/PORTFOLIO.md\")
add_test(NAME queue-contract COMMAND task_queue_tests)
install(TARGETS concurrent-task-queue RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
